text.p: Solv-Ex Corp said the scope of activities under the limited partnership agreement with United Tri-Star Resources Ltd for oil operations on the Bitumount Lease in Northern Alberta have expanded.

Solv-Ex is General Partner for the partnership, which will be known as the Solv-Ex Canada LP, owned 90 percent by Solv-Ex and 10 percent by Tri-Star, which has funded its share of expenditures to date.
Solv-Ex said the companies have entered into a separate agreement in contemplation of co-production of minerals from the lease or other properties using Solv-Ex technology.

Under the second agreement, Tri-Star will be contributing 10 percent of on-going costs incurred at the Solv-Ex pilot plant in Albuquerque after July 1, 1995, Solv-Ex said without disclosing the amount or form of this payment.
Tri-Star has the option to acquire 10 percent of any working interests acquired by Solv-Ex in oil sands projects which use the Solv-Ex technology.

In addition to the Bitumount Lease, which is expected to commence production operations in the first quarter of 1997, Solv-Ex and Tri-Star also own the much larger adjoining Fort Hills oil sands lease acquired in 1995 from Petro-Canada.
